name: Josh Hawley
bio: Josh Hawley is a Senator representing MO.

comments.text: Mr. President, had there been a recorded vote on Calendar No. 311, H.R. 7147, Department of Homeland Security Appropriations Act, 2026, as amended, I would have voted nay. In addition, had there been a recorded vote on tabling the House message to accompany H.R. 7147, I would have voted nay.
